settings.text:
SeaWorld Destinations - Book with Mr Chocolate's Travel

With parks spanning the globe, SeaWorld brings the wonder of the ocean to guests everywhere through unforgettable animal encounters, thrilling rides, and immersive experiences. This includes SeaWorld Orlando, SeaWorld San Diego, SeaWorld San Antonio, and the all-new SeaWorld Abu Dhabi—each offering unique ways to connect with marine life and celebrate the beauty of the natural world.

settings.heading: SeaWorld Orlando
settings.text: Dive into adventure at SeaWorld Orlando, where thrilling rides, up-close animal encounters, and world-class shows come together in one unforgettable destination. Experience pulse-pounding coasters like Mako and Ice Breaker, meet majestic marine life from dolphins to orcas, and explore immersive realms like Antarctica: Empire of the Penguin. Perfect for families and thrill-seekers alike, with seasonal festivals and all-new attractions making every visit unique.

settings.heading: SeaWorld San Diego
settings.text: Explore the wonders of the ocean at SeaWorld San Diego, where marine life meets high-energy thrills in a scenic coastal setting. From awe-inspiring animal presentations to adrenaline-pumping rides like Emperor and Electric Eel, there's something for every kind of adventurer. Discover hands-on exhibits, playful sea otters, and unforgettable dolphin encounters. With year-round events, kid-friendly fun, and breathtaking views of Mission Bay, it's a can't-miss destination for families and ocean lovers alike.

settings.heading: SeaWorld Abu Dhabi
settings.text: Embark on a journey beneath the waves at SeaWorld Abu Dhabi, the region’s first marine life theme park blending world-class entertainment with ocean education. Spread across immersive realms like Endless Ocean and Tropical Ocean, it features awe-inspiring animal habitats, thrilling rides, and interactive exhibits. With cutting-edge technology, up-close encounters, and fun for all ages, it’s a groundbreaking experience that celebrates the wonders of the sea—right on Yas Island.
